briefdescription.para: Adds a requirement that another module flag be present and have a specified value after linking is performed.

detaileddescription.para: The value must be a metadata pair, where the first element of the pair is the ID of the module flag to be restricted, and the second element of the pair is the value the module flag should be restricted to. This behavior can be used to restrict the allowable results (via triggering of an error) of linking IDs with the Override behavior.

briefdescription.para: Uses the specified value, regardless of the behavior or value of the other module.

detaileddescription.para: If both modules specify Override, but the values differ, an error will be emitted.
